test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Among the following, which state of India does not recognize Jews as a religious minority?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **States of India grants Religious Minority to Jews**

 
 
• The **Jewish community in India** is one of many communities that have **migrated from outside the nation's current territorial boundaries** and settled in India.
 
• The local **non-Jewish majority has rarely shown anti-Semitic behaviour** toward the **small religious minority of Indian Jews**.
 
• Jews have been a part of Indian society for more than **2,300 years**.
 
• The** first state **to grant Jews a minority status in **Maharashtra**.
 
• A decade-long demand by one of India's smallest communities was finally met in **June 2016 at a state cabinet meeting presided over by the former Chief Minister of Maharashtra, Devendra Fadnavis**.
 
• The other two states that have given their Jewish communities minority status are **West Bengal and Gujarat**.
 
• **Kerala** **does not recognize Jews as a religious minority**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Union Government of India **has designated **six religious groups as minority communities** across the country that are: **Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Zoroastrians (Parsis), and Jains**.
 
• **Judaism**
 
 
• More than** 3500 years ago, in the Middle East**, Judaism first emerged.
 
• Although Jews can trace their origins to Abraham, **Moses is credited with founding Judaism**.
 
• Jews hold to the notion that there is** just one God** with whom they are in covenant.
 
• Jewish people **follow God's instructions and strive to make purity a part of every element of their lives **in return for all the good things God has done for them.
 
• The** Torah** is the central and most significant religious literature in Judaism despite having a long and rich history of religious texts.
 
• **Synagogues** are places of prayer for Jews.
